content:
No, you're not correct. 9.9 is greater than 9.11.

It's a common mistake that seems to come from thinking of the numbers after the decimal point as whole numbers (where 11 > 9). But decimal places don't work that way. You can think of 9.9 as 9.90 — and 90 hundredths is greater than 11 hundredths.
